scope: Production before/after at the same 30 km camera distance and exact saved pose matrices. Same viewport and DPR. Baseline shared shell predates the independently merged moon-system PR106; no renderer or Halley geometry is changed by this PR. Different photography is expected; this is a coverage comparison, not an image-parity claim.
